summary.text: Bob Behning is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 91 who has represented the district since 1992 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works at Marian University and previously owned Berkshire Florist.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Jarren Hurt, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: Behning holds a bachelor's degree from Indiana University.
His professional experience includes working as an assistant vice president at Marian University, and he has also owned Berkshire Florist.
He took office in the Indiana House in 1992.
